explanation: Matches erdosproblems.com/205 with the negative answer (Barreto–Leeham; quantified by Tao–Alexeev): not all large n are 2^k + m with Ω(m) < log log m. Junk values at small m (log log m ≤ 0 for m ≤ 2) make those m non-representable, which only helps the negation and is irrelevant for large n.
